note: V2 encoders on the WORKSTATION GPU (RTX 5070 Ti). Specs (repo, revision, prefixes, pooling) come from benchmarks/retrieval_v0/configs/models.json by `spec`; this file adds only the V2 run settings. Licenses are the `license:` field of each pinned model card (FACT). `rx580_key` = the encoder key of vkm_corpus.embeddings.specs (Q8_0 GGUF gate of agent K) or null when no GGUF exists on the pin.

text.why: the deployed model re-encoded in the V2 harness: separates the harness/precision effect (GPU bf16 vs RX580 Q8_0) from the model effect
dense output only (CLS + L2 through the model's own sentence-transformers modules)
contextual late chunking: windows of consecutive dense-index units of one source in export order; queries as one-chunk windows (as in V0)

visual.query_prompt: Find a document image that matches the given query.
visual.why: document side: the model's default instruction on the page image alone; query side: a visual-document instruction in English (model card: task instructions in English), fixed before any evaluation
